descriptionMarkdown:
Protector Protocol; When an ally within 30 ft is targeted by an attack, you may use your reaction before the roll is resolved to give that ally +2 AC against the attack if you can see the attacker.

Protector; If the protected attack misses, the ally gains temporary HP equal to your Intelligence modifier.

Protector; When you use your reaction to protect an ally, reduce damage by your Intelligence modifier if the attack still hits.

Protector; Your protection reaction may target two allies within 30 ft.
